_comment: Country-code TLD RDAP endpoints that are NOT in the IANA bootstrap.
Every entry here was verified by performing a real RDAP domain lookup and
requiring an object with objectClassName/ldhName/events in the response.
Generated 2026-09-28. Regenerating this file is a deliberate, reviewed step:
it is research data, not a build-time fetch.

tr.note: TRABIS (the .tr registry) does not offer RDAP; it is a ccTLD not bound by ICANN's gTLD agreements, so registration data is only available through TRABIS WHOIS.
